title: Buttons | Apple Developer Documentation - [visionOS](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons\#visionOS)
claim: Avoid creating a custom button that uses a white background fill and black text or icons.** The system reserves this visual style to convey the toggled state.
supporting_text: **Avoid creating a custom button that uses a white background fill and black text or icons.** The system reserves this visual style to convey the toggled state.
